James Earl Jones is the latest star to fall victim to a death hoax.
The 84-year-old actor is still very much alive, but after a parody website posted news of his supposed demise many thought he had passed away.
The link, however, took users to a page that declared, "You got owned!" Not everyone caught onto the hoax, as Facebook saw the death announcement and posted the news on the social media platform.
